newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Government employees in the central secretariat on Wednesday called off their agaitation programme against the new office timing between 9 am to 5 pm.
Bangladesh's top business leader has said implementation of the new pay scale for government employees will hit the economy hard.
Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria said the 1997-98 budget, due to be placed in parliament later on Thursday, would enormously benefit the common people.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Wednesday said embankments would be built along the entire coastal belt.
Bangladesh has sought Dutch assistance for land reclamation from the sea.
The cabinet has turned down a proposal by the Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation to raise the prices of petroleum products.
Top ranking policy makers of Dhaka and New Delhi are likely to meet in Dhaka in August to discuss the issue of allowing India the land transit.
High price of sulphuric acid has badly affected the country's alum industries. REUTER
